name: Calibre
line: Haute-horlogerie night: a finely engraved midnight dial holds the four IARC groups, and its faceted leaf hand sweeps from Group 3 to Group 1 as you scroll, with a date-style window naming the group; two sub-dials compare smokers and non-smokers on one 0–150 per 1,000 scale.
notes: No photographs; the dial, sub-dials and case rings are SVG drawn for the page and the network drawings are recoloured champagne with a CSS filter. Bodoni Moda is Latin-only, so Chinese and Russian pages would need a display fallback (Manrope covers Cyrillic). The hand rests on Group 1 with JavaScript off or reduced motion.
